verdict.rationale: The only evidence of natural-language operation is one community remark that Outlook has a Copilot integration, which the user found slower than copy-pasting into another client. The Graph API docs are developer building blocks, and the LLM-via-MCP search is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of natural-language commands in Outlook, the scope of actions Copilot can perform (drafting, searching, triaging, scheduling), and hands-on corroboration that it works well.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: copy-pasting into Thunderbird is still faster than using Copilot in Outlook
